content.text: {"answer":"None of the supplied papers address making better picture descriptions using a shared model that creates and checks specific quality rules through a moving average. The closest related idea is using an exponential moving average of parameters to improve deployment in a transformer policy trained with self-play reinforcement learning for Generals.io, but that work is about game-playing rather than picture description quality rules [1].\n\nOther papers in the list focus on different self-play/RL setups (e.g., AlphaZero-style self-play for board games, including stabilization methods like separate heads and replay/augmentation) rather than language-based image captioning or quality-rule checking [2]. Search self-play similarly targets training search agents with verifiable task ground truth, not image description rule enforcement [4].","grounded":false}
